description:
Independent reviews of recent Theseus PRs left non-blocking notes. Each was re-checked on main 97691757 on 2026-11-20; line numbers drift.
1. src/theseus_reviewer/layout.py:44: `_REFERENCE` only matches a reference label on one line (`[^\]\n]*\]:`). CommonMark allows a label to span lines, so a split `[label\n]: dest` passes through `neutralize` unchanged and can create a relative link. Impact is low because sanitizing already removes absolute URLs.
2. src/theseus_reviewer/suggestions.py:50: `target.is_symlink()` is checked on the already-resolved path, so it is always False and a symlinked file inside the workspace is read through to its target. The containment check still blocks escapes outside the workspace.
3. src/theseus_reviewer/dashboard.py:45: when one finding has several bot threads in the same cycle, `setdefault` keeps whichever comes first, which may be an older thread instead of the current one.
4. src/theseus_reviewer/check_run.py:39: annotation messages are plain text, but `layout.neutralize` replaces raw tags with `<`, so the entity appears literally in check-run annotations.
5. src/theseus_reviewer/infra/rotate_command.py:56-64 reads the environment with its own `gh api` call and repeats the 'unreadable or open environment' refusal, while setup uses `github_env.get_environment` plus `is_restricted` (setup.py:417). Both refuse correctly; the duplication means the two paths can drift.
